title: Hyperliquid HIP-3 open-interest hits $793M on commodities surge
summary: Hyperliquid's HIP-3, also known as "Builder Deployed Perpetuals," lets anyone who stakes 500,000 HYPE to create a new perpetual futures market on the Hyperliquid blockchain.

title: Viral AI assistant 'Clawdbot' risks leaking private messages, credentials
summary: A security vulnerability in the Clawdbot AI assistant has exposed hundreds of servers, leaking API keys and other sensitive information due to misconfigured proxies, cybersecurity professionals warn.

title: Meta exec denies having access to WhatsApp chats amid privacy lawsuit
summary: Plaintiffs in a US district court lawsuit accused Meta of having backdoor access to WhatsApp chats, impacting the privacy of its more than 3 billion users.

title: Polymarket strikes prediction market deal with major US soccer league
summary: Polymarket will be the prediction market partner for the US Major League Soccer with the plan to offer “ways to engage more deeply with the game.”

title: Bitwise to launch onchain vaults via Moprho
summary: The first vault strategy targets 6% annual percentage yield via over-collateralized lending pools, managed by Bitwise.

title: Bitcoin hashrate briefly drops to mid-2025 levels amid US winter storm
summary: Bitcoin mining data platform Hashrate Index estimates the United States contributes the largest amount of the world’s mining power, with nearly 38% of the global hashrate.

title: Fundstrat’s Lee sees a crypto comeback once precious metals cool
summary: Fundstrat’s Tom Lee said crypto markets are being overshadowed by record gold and silver prices, but predicts a surge will come once precious metals' rally takes a pause.

title: Bitcoin job listings rise 6% in 2025, led by non-technical roles
summary: The most in-demand, non-developer Bitcoin job openings included product manager, executive assistant, marketing manager, director and product designer.

title: Ether price gained 200% the last time this global liquidity signal flashed
summary: ETH whale accumulation and its alignment with a rare global liquidity signal could be a sign that Ether price is gearing up for another triple-digit rally.

title: Stablecoin market fall shows flight to gold, not Bitcoin: Santiment
summary: Bitcoin has fallen nearly 30% since a major market crash in October, while gold and silver have soared to new highs.
